title: Acquisition by Tausi Forests Limited (A Joint Venture Company) of 50 Percent Shares in New Forest Company (Tanzania) Limited
title_sw: Acquisition by Tausi Forests Limited (A Joint Venture Company) of 50 Percent Shares in New Forest Company (Tanzania) Limited
text: New Forests Company Holdings I Limited and Shell Overseas Holdings Limited notified the Fair Competition Commission (“FCC”) that New Forests Holdings I Limited and Shell Overseas Holdings Limited has reached a definitive agreement to form permanent Joint Venture Company to be known as Tausi Forests Limited (“JVCo”). A newly formed joint venture company will acquire 50 percent shares in New Forests Company (Tanzania) Limited, a company wholly owned subsidiary of New Forests Company Holdings I Limited. The relevant market defined as commercialization of carbon credit in Mainland Tanzania. Based on the analysis of the industry, pre and post-merger concentration ratio in the relevant market, there is no likelihood for the post-merger firm to have adverse effects to competition therefore, the transaction was approved without conditions.
